references.text: The Lord speaks to Moses and Aaron together, giving them instructions concerning the Israelites and Pharaoh.
Moses and Aaron are mentioned together as those the Lord spoke to in order to lead the Israelites out of Egypt.
The Lord speaks to Moses and Aaron together in Egypt with instructions.
Reference to the Exodus of the Israelites from Egypt under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
Moses and Aaron are mentioned as servants of the Lord who were sent to Egypt.
Reference to Passover and the application of blood that Moses instituted according to the Lord's command in Egypt.
